issues.title: Incorrect tauri version in metadata file
issues.description: The metadata-v2.json file specifies tauri version as "2.8.2" but the actual tauri crate version is "2.8.3" as shown in crates/tauri/Cargo.toml. This version mismatch will cause the CLI to report incorrect version information to tools and scripts that depend on this metadata. The PR updated the tauri version to 2.8.3, but the metadata file was not updated accordingly, creating an inconsistency between the actual library version and the advertised version.

issues.title: Dependency version mismatch for tauri-bundler
issues.description: The tauri-cli Cargo.toml declares a dependency on tauri-bundler version "2.6.0", but the actual tauri-bundler crate version is "2.6.1" as specified in crates/tauri-bundler/Cargo.toml. This creates a version constraint mismatch that could cause build failures or prevent the CLI from using the updated bundler with the bug fix for 32-bit Windows builds. The CHANGELOG indicates this version should have been updated to 2.6.1 to pick up the binary patching fix.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14070 - Apply Version Updates From Current Changes

structured_output.summary:
This is a release-automation PR (covector) that bumps `tauri` 2.8.2→2.8.3, `tauri-bundler` 2.6.0→2.6.1, `tauri-cli` 2.8.0→2.8.1, and `@tauri-apps/cli` 2.8.1→2.8.2, then updates the derived artifacts: `Cargo.lock`, CHANGELOGs, both copies of `config.schema.json` (`$id` 2.8.3), `metadata-v2.json`, and `packages/cli/package.json`.

The generated release commit is correct on its own, but the follow-up "update pr" commit reintroduces two version regressions: it sets `metadata-v2.json`'s `tauri` field back to 2.8.2 and `tauri-cli`'s `tauri-bundler` requirement back to 2.6.0. Because both values were 2.8.2/2.6.0 at the base, these reverts cancel the generated changes out and appear as unchanged context in the base..head diff. The metadata revert is a guaranteed CI failure (the schema generator stamps `$id` from it), and the dependency revert silently drops the very fix this release exists to ship. Both should be fixed before merge.
structured_output.verdictRationale: Two version regressions are hidden in the PR: `metadata-v2.json` still pins `tauri` to 2.8.2, which will make `check-generated-files.yml` regenerate the schema `$id` as 2.8.2 and fail against the committed 2.8.3; and `tauri-cli` still requires `tauri-bundler 2.6.0`, contradicting the CHANGELOG and allowing consumers to miss the 32-bit binary-patching fix. Neither is visible as a changed line in the diff.

architecture.overview:
This PR is produced by the repo's release tooling (covector). It consumes two `.changes/*.md` fragments and bumps four package versions — `tauri` 2.8.2→2.8.3, `tauri-bundler` 2.6.0→2.6.1, `tauri-cli` 2.8.0→2.8.1, and `@tauri-apps/cli` 2.8.1→2.8.2 — then ripples those versions into derived artifacts: `Cargo.lock`, per-crate CHANGELOGs, both copies of `config.schema.json` (`$id` 2.8.3), `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json`, and `packages/cli/package.json`.

The release is bound together by `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json`. Its `tauri` field is read at build time by `crates/tauri-schema-generator/build.rs` to stamp the schema `$id`, and by `tauri init` to write the `tauri` dependency into newly scaffolded projects; its `cli.js.version` drives the CLI release tag. Separately, `tauri-cli` declares a path+version dependency on `tauri-bundler`. The PR's follow-up commit edits three files on top of the generated bump, and two of those edits move these versions backwards.
steps: Start at the two removed change fragments in `.changes/`: they declare `patch:bug` for `tauri-bundler` and `tauri`.
The generated commit bumps the crate manifests and `packages/cli/package.json`, then regenerates CHANGELOGs, `Cargo.lock`, and both `config.schema.json` files.
`metadata-v2.json` is updated to `cli.js.version = 2.8.2` and `tauri = 2.8.3`; the `tauri` value is the source of truth for the schema `$id` and for `tauri init`.
`crates/tauri-cli/Cargo.toml` should require `tauri-bundler 2.6.1` so the published CLI pulls in the binary-patching fix.

The head commit edits `metadata-v2.json` back to `tauri = 2.8.2`, `Cargo.toml` back to `tauri-bundler = 2.6.0`, and adds a `homepage` field — the first two cancel the generated changes out of the base..head diff.
CI's `check-generated-files.yml` schema job rebuilds the generator and fails on any diff; the stale metadata causes it to rewrite both schemas back to `$id` 2.8.2.

findings.title: metadata-v2.json still pins tauri to 2.8.2, breaking schema CI
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json`, line 6 still sets `"tauri": "2.8.2"` even though the `tauri` crate was bumped to 2.8.3. Change it to `2.8.3`. This value is consumed by `crates/tauri-schema-generator/build.rs` (it sets the config schema `$id`) and by `tauri init` (`crates/tauri-cli/src/init.rs`), so leaving it stale makes the `check-generated-files.yml` schema job regenerate `$id` as 2.8.2 and fail against the committed 2.8.3 schemas. After changing it, confirm both `config.schema.json` files still read 2.8.3.

findings.title: tauri-cli still requires tauri-bundler 2.6.0, contradicting the release
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-cli/Cargo.toml` line 50, the `tauri-bundler` dependency still says `version = "2.6.0"`, but this release bumps tauri-bundler to 2.6.1 and `crates/tauri-cli/CHANGELOG.md` advertises `Upgraded to tauri-bundler@2.6.1`. Change the requirement to `2.6.1` so published tauri-cli 2.8.1 actually requires the bundler containing the 32-bit Windows binary-patching fix. Preserve the `path = "../tauri-bundler"` and `default-features = false` attributes, and verify `Cargo.lock` still resolves tauri-bundler to 2.6.1.

findings.title: Cargo.lock silently rewrites unrelated windows dependency edges
Unrelated homepage field added to tauri-bundler manifest
Mechanical release bookkeeping is otherwise consistent
findings.body: The mechanical parts of the bump line up: `Cargo.lock` records tauri 2.8.3 / tauri-bundler 2.6.1 / tauri-cli 2.8.1, `packages/cli/package.json` and `metadata-v2.json`'s `cli.js.version` are both 2.8.2, both `config.schema.json` copies carry `$id` 2.8.3, and the two consumed `.changes/*.md` fragments are removed. Apart from the two regressions flagged above, the release metadata is consistent.
